Use `snl macro get` to retrieve one exact Macro and its current opaque revision.

### Agent procedure
1. Supply the exact macro ID; do not substitute a display title.
2. Preserve the returned revision for an immediate guarded update, rename, or delete; reread if any other writer may have intervened.

### Machine-use contract
Invoke `snl macro get` with an explicit `--root` and `--json`. Treat returned IDs and revisions as opaque. Branch on the structured status and exit code; do not scrape human-formatted output or edit `.SNL_Doc` files directly.
